hero.subtitle: The "First Mile" of clinical care is catastrophically broken for neurodivergent populations. Patients face an impossible task: compressing complex, continuous lived experiences into 15 pages of arbitrary paperwork and a rushed 5-minute clinical documentation. Engineered by the Humanos NGO, Aura hOS™ is the open-source technological crown jewel built to solve this crisis—giving you absolute sovereignty over your clinical narrative before you ever enter the hospital.
